fact: On 1 July 2021 Uganda rolled out the e-GP in 12 pilot entities; by March 2024 36 entities were enrolled, and the e-GP conducts end-to-end procurement planning, bidding, evaluation, award, contract management, invoicing and payment, with all entities to be on it by end 2025/2026.
title: The PPDA at A Glance in 2024
